topic: UI/UX Fundamentals, User Research, and Design Thinking
learningObjectives: Explain the differences between UI design and UX design.
Identify user needs through basic research and observation.
Apply design thinking stages to a digital product problem.

content.concept: UI focuses on the interface and visual interaction, while UX focuses on the overall user experience and problem-solving process.
